title: How I Diagnose a Broken AI Email Automation

sections.label: 1 · DIAGNOSE
sections.note: With AI in the loop there's an extra place it can break, the generation step itself, not just the trigger and the send.

sections.label: 2 · FIX & CONFIRM
sections.note: The fix goes exactly where the diagnosis pointed, then gets proven with a real test run, content included.

nodes.label: Confirm the Exact Symptom: No Email, Bad Content, or Wrong Recipient
Check Whether the Automation Trigger Actually Fired
Check the AI Generation Step: Valid Output, Timeout, or Malformed Response
Check the Send Step: Correct Recipient, Correct Template Slot
Isolate the Root Cause: Trigger, Generation, or Send
Apply the Fix at the Exact Point of Failure
Re-Run the Automation End to End and Read the Generated Email
Confirm the Fix Holds Before Handing It Back

input_sample.reported_symptom: Emails are sending but the body text is empty half the time
input_sample.generation_check: AI call succeeds but occasionally returns an empty string when the input record is missing a field the prompt assumes exists
input_sample.root_cause: no fallback when the source record is incomplete, prompt has no guard for missing fields

output_sample.fix_applied: added a fallback template and a required-field check before the AI call runs
output_sample.test_result: 10 test records with missing fields all produced valid email bodies
